# Error Code Reference

## Error Codes and Troubleshooting

Meshery and its components use a common framework (defined within MeshKit) to generate and document an event with a unique error code identifier as the combination of `[component type]-[component name]-[event moniker]-[numeric code]`. Each error code identifies the source component for the error and a standard set of information to describe the error and provide helpful details for troubleshooting the situation surrounding the specific error.

Each error code has a stable page. Its URL follows this pattern:

```text
/reference/error-codes/<component-type>-<component-name>/<event-moniker>-<code>/
```

The [machine-readable error code index](./index.json) is a
[meshery/schemas](https://github.com/meshery/schemas/blob/master/docs/error-definition-contract.md)
`ErrorReferenceIndex` (`schemaVersion` 2). It holds one `ErrorDefinition` per
code: its full `code` (for example `meshery-server-1304`), `moniker`,
`component`, `severity`, descriptions and `referenceUrl`. Where a component
pairs each probable cause with the remediations that address it, the entry
carries `probableCauses`, each with its own `remediations`; every entry carries
the flat `probableCause` and `suggestedRemediation` lists.

<div class="alert alert-info" role="alert"><div class="h4 alert-heading" role="heading">Error codes are combination of component type, component name, event moniker and numeric code</div>

Error codes are a hyphenated collection of details that include:

<ul>
<li><b>Component Type</b> (string): The type of the component that emits this error event; e.g. <code>adapter</code></li>
<li><b>Component Name</b> (string): The name of the component that emits this error event; e.g. <code>meshery-istio</code></li>
<li><b>Error Moniker</b> (string): A semi-human readable short key used in descriptive reference to the specific event at-hand; e.g. <code>ErrClosingDatabaseInstanceCode</code></li>
<li><b>Numeric Code</b> (number): Unique number identifying a specific error as scoped by a specific component; e.g. <code>1000</code></li>
</ul>
The numeric portion of error codes are component-scoped. The numeric portion of error codes are allowed to overlap between Meshery components. The combination of the <code>[component type]-[component name]-[event moniker]-[numeric code]</code> is what makes a given error code globally unique.</div>

              <p class="error-details">Error occurred while parsing application component in the OAM request made by Meshery Server</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">Could not unmarshall configuration component received via ProcessOAM gRPC call into a valid Component struct</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Check if Meshery Server is creating valid component for ProcessOAM gRPC call. This error should never happen and can be reported as a bug in Meshery Server.             <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details">Error occurred while parsing application component in the OAM request made by Meshery server</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">Could not unmarshall configuration component received via ProcessOAM gRPC call into a valid Component struct</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Check if Meshery Server is creating valid component for ProcessOAM gRPC call. This error should never happen and can be reported as a bug in Meshery Server. Also check if Meshery Server and adapters are referring to same component struct provided in MeshKit.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>

              <p class="error-details">Error occurred while parsing application component in the OAM request made by Meshery server</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">Could not unmarshall configuration component received via ProcessOAM gRPC call into a valid Component struct</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Check if Meshery Server is creating valid component for ProcessOAM gRPC call. This error should never happen and can be reported as a bug in Meshery Server. Also check if Meshery Server and adapters are referring to same component struct provided in MeshKit.</p>
            </td>

            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details">Error occurred while parsing application component in the OAM request made by Meshery server</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">Could not unmarshall configuration component received via ProcessOAM gRPC call into a valid Component struct</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Check if Meshery Server is creating valid component for ProcessOAM gRPC call. This error should never happen and can be reported as a bug in Meshery Server. Also check if Meshery Server and adapters are referring to same component struct provided in MeshKit.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>

            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The design ID in the URL is malformed or does not exist.
The design has been deleted by its owner.
Your account does not have permission to view this design — it may belong to another organization or be set to private.
Your session has expired or the remote provider is currently unreachable.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Verify the design link — confirm the full design ID is intact, with no missing or extra characters.
Open My Designs and confirm the design still exists; if it was shared with you, ask the owner to re-share or grant access.
Sign out and sign back in to refresh your session, then retry.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>

              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The design ID is malformed or no longer exists — it may already have been deleted.
Your account does not have permission to delete this design — only authorized users (such as the owner) can delete it.
Your session has expired or the remote provider is currently unreachable.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Refresh the designs list to confirm the design still exists before retrying.
If the design was shared with you, ask its owner to delete it.
Sign out and sign back in to refresh your session, then retry.</p>
            </td>

Network connectivity between Meshery Server and the remote provider has been interrupted.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Check your network connection and reload the page.
Sign out and sign back in to refresh your session, then retry.
Confirm that the configured remote provider is online.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>

            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details">Meshery Server did not get an answer from the cluster&#39;s API server.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The Kubernetes API server is not reachable.
Credentials are invalid.
The cluster&#39;s serving certificate is not trusted by Meshery Server.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Verify network connectivity and Kubernetes API responsiveness between Meshery Server and your cluster.
Once the cause is fixed, reconnect the cluster&#39;s connection from Connections, or wait for Meshery Server to discover it again.
Ensure client credential is not expired and is properly formed.
Remove the cluster credential and enable &#39;insecure-skip-tls-verify&#39;.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>

              <p class="error-details">Remote provider is unreachable.
Connection has been deleted since it was loaded.
Persisted metadata is corrupt.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Verify provider connectivity and that the connection still exists, then retry.</p>

          <tr id="ErrExportModelCode-1414" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrExportModelCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrExportModelCode-more-info');">

            </td>
            <td></td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrExportModelCode-1414" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrExportModelCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">Temp directory is not writable.
Model definition references a missing dependency.
OCI/tar tooling produced an invalid artifact.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Retry the export; if it persists, inspect server logs and disk availability under the temp directory.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrInvalidContextsConfigCode-1415" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrInvalidContextsConfigCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrInvalidContextsConfigCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1415" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errinvalidcontextsconfigcode-1415/"><code>ErrInvalidContextsConfigCode-1415</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Invalid contexts configuration</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrInvalidContextsConfigCode-1415" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrInvalidContextsConfigCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The `contexts` form field is not a valid JSON map from context ID to {meshsync_deployment_mode: string}.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Send a well-formed JSON object in the `contexts` form field, e.g. {&#34;&lt;contextID&gt;&#34;: {&#34;meshsync_deployment_mode&#34;: &#34;operator&#34;}}.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrEmptyConnectionIDCode-1416" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrEmptyConnectionIDCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrEmptyConnectionIDCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1416" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/erremptyconnectionidcode-1416/"><code>ErrEmptyConnectionIDCode-1416</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Empty connection ID</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrEmptyConnectionIDCode-1416" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrEmptyConnectionIDCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details">No connection ID was supplied in the canonical `connectionId` query parameter (the legacy `connection_id` spelling is also accepted during the Phase 2 deprecation window).</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The client did not pass `connectionId` in the query string.
A URL template did not get its parameter substituted.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Pass the connection ID of the Kubernetes context to be pinged, e.g. /api/system/kubernetes/ping?connectionId=&lt;id&gt;.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrPolicyEvalTimeoutCode-1417" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrPolicyEvalTimeoutCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrPolicyEvalTimeoutCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1417" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errpolicyevaltimeoutcode-1417/"><code>ErrPolicyEvalTimeoutCode-1417</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Relationship policy evaluation timed out</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrPolicyEvalTimeoutCode-1417" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrPolicyEvalTimeoutCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The design is large enough that the policy engine needs more than the configured timeout.
One of the Rego/Go policies under evaluation is in a slow path or infinite loop.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Increase the POLICY_EVAL_TIMEOUT setting (default 3m) if the design genuinely needs more time, or retry with a smaller design.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrPolicyEvalCode-1418" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrPolicyEvalCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrPolicyEvalCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1418" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errpolicyevalcode-1418/"><code>ErrPolicyEvalCode-1418</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Relationship policy evaluation failed</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrPolicyEvalCode-1418" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrPolicyEvalCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">A registered relationship policy returned an error during evaluation.
A cycle or invalid declaration in the design triggered an engine panic recovered as an error.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Inspect server logs for the underlying policy error. If the design has recently been edited, revert the most recent change and retry.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrInvalidBase64DataCode-1419" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrInvalidBase64DataCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrInvalidBase64DataCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1419" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errinvalidbase64datacode-1419/"><code>ErrInvalidBase64DataCode-1419</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Invalid base64 data</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrInvalidBase64DataCode-1419" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrInvalidBase64DataCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The supplied payload was not a valid base64-encoded string.
The payload may have been corrupted in transit or encoded with the wrong alphabet (URL-safe vs. standard).</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Verify the client is base64-encoding the file with the standard alphabet before sending it.
If the payload was hand-edited, re-encode it from the source bytes and retry.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrRemoteProviderCapabilitiesCode-1420" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrRemoteProviderCapabilitiesCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrRemoteProviderCapabilitiesCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1420" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errremoteprovidercapabilitiescode-1420/"><code>ErrRemoteProviderCapabilitiesCode-1420</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Failed to load capabilities from remote provider</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrRemoteProviderCapabilitiesCode-1420" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrRemoteProviderCapabilitiesCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">Remote provider is unreachable, the manifest endpoint is down, or the response is malformed.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Verify the remote provider is reachable, check its manifest endpoint, and retry.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrRemoteProviderAuthExhaustedCode-1421" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrRemoteProviderAuthExhaustedCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrRemoteProviderAuthExhaustedCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1421" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errremoteproviderauthexhaustedcode-1421/"><code>ErrRemoteProviderAuthExhaustedCode-1421</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Authentication failed after multiple attempts</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrRemoteProviderAuthExhaustedCode-1421" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrRemoteProviderAuthExhaustedCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">Invalid or expired credentials, or the auth endpoint is rejecting requests.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Log out and sign in again; if this persists, check that the remote provider&#39;s auth endpoint is healthy.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrInvalidImportRequestCode-1422" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrInvalidImportRequestCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrInvalidImportRequestCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1422" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errinvalidimportrequestcode-1422/"><code>ErrInvalidImportRequestCode-1422</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Invalid design import request</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrInvalidImportRequestCode-1422" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrInvalidImportRequestCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The request body did not match exactly one variant of the import oneOf — the File variant requires `file` and `fileName`, the URL variant requires `url`.
Both variants were provided, or neither was.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Send a request body with exactly one variant set: either {&#34;file&#34;: &lt;bytes&gt;, &#34;fileName&#34;: &#34;design.yml&#34;} or {&#34;url&#34;: &#34;https://...&#34;}.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrConvertToDesignCode-1423" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrConvertToDesignCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrConvertToDesignCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1423" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errconverttodesigncode-1423/"><code>ErrConvertToDesignCode-1423</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Failed to convert uploaded file to a design</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrConvertToDesignCode-1423" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrConvertToDesignCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The uploaded file extension is not one of the supported import formats (.yml, .yaml, .json, .tar, .tar.gz, .tgz, .zip).
The file is corrupt or its content does not parse as the type implied by its extension.
The Kubernetes manifest references a kind/apiVersion that does not match any registered component definition.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Verify the file is one of the supported formats and content-types, and that it parses cleanly outside Meshery.
If the source is a Kubernetes manifest, ensure each kind it references has a corresponding model registered in the Meshery registry.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrCompressArtifactCode-1424" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrCompressArtifactCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrCompressArtifactCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1424" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errcompressartifactcode-1424/"><code>ErrCompressArtifactCode-1424</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Failed to compress design as OCI artifact</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrCompressArtifactCode-1424" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrCompressArtifactCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The server-side tar writer hit an I/O error while packaging the design YAML and the artifacthub-pkg metadata.
Available memory or disk for the in-memory archive buffer was exhausted.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Retry the export. If the failure persists, inspect server logs for the underlying writer error and ensure the host has sufficient resources.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrWriteRegistryLogsCode-1425" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrWriteRegistryLogsCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrWriteRegistryLogsCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1425" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errwriteregistrylogscode-1425/"><code>ErrWriteRegistryLogsCode-1425</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Failed to flush registry logs</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrWriteRegistryLogsCode-1425" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrWriteRegistryLogsCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The path configured in REGISTRY_LOG_FILE is not writable by the Meshery process (missing directory, missing permissions, or the disk is full).
An in-memory log entry could not be marshaled into the on-disk format.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Verify REGISTRY_LOG_FILE points to a writable path with sufficient free disk and that the Meshery process owns or has write permission to its parent directory.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrUpdateEntityStatusCode-1426" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrUpdateEntityStatusCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrUpdateEntityStatusCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1426" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errupdateentitystatuscode-1426/"><code>ErrUpdateEntityStatusCode-1426</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Failed to update entity status</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrUpdateEntityStatusCode-1426" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrUpdateEntityStatusCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The entity ID does not exist in the registry.
The registry&#39;s persistence layer rejected the status update — typically a database connection or transaction failure.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Verify the entity ID exists by listing the entities of the same type. If it does, retry the request and inspect server logs for the underlying registry error.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrExtensionProxyCode-1427" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrExtensionProxyCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrExtensionProxyCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1427" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errextensionproxycode-1427/"><code>ErrExtensionProxyCode-1427</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Extension proxy request failed</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrExtensionProxyCode-1427" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrExtensionProxyCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The remote provider could not be reached (network failure, DNS resolution, or TLS handshake failure).
The remote provider returned a non-2xx response that the proxy could not translate.
The active provider is the local provider, which has no extensions backend.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Verify the remote provider is reachable from this Meshery instance and that the user&#39;s session token has not expired. Retry the request after re-authenticating if the failure persists.
If running against the local provider, switch to a remote provider that exposes the extensions surface.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrInitializeMachineCode-1428" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrInitializeMachineCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrInitializeMachineCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1428" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errinitializemachinecode-1428/"><code>ErrInitializeMachineCode-1428</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Failed to initialize connection state machine</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrInitializeMachineCode-1428" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrInitializeMachineCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The connection kind has no registered machine type in the state-machine registry.
The state machine&#39;s persister could not write the initial state to the database.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Verify the connection kind is one of the supported types. If it is, retry the request and inspect server logs for the underlying machine-bootstrap error.</p>

              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The performance profiles could not be read from the database
The performance_profiles table is out of sync with the performance profile model</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Inspect the underlying database error reported above
Make sure the Meshery database schema is up to date with the running Meshery Server</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrOperatorHandlerNotAttachedCode-1465" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrOperatorHandlerNotAttachedCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrOperatorHandlerNotAttachedCode-more-info');">

            </td>
            <td>No Meshery Operator controller handler is attached</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrOperatorHandlerNotAttachedCode-1465" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>

          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrOperatorHandlerNotAttachedCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The connection&#39;s kubeconfig could not be generated, or the Kubernetes client could not be created.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Reconnect the Kubernetes connection and retry; the configuration is re-applied on connect.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrReconcileOperatorChartVersionCode-1466" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrReconcileOperatorChartVersionCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrReconcileOperatorChartVersionCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1466" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errreconcileoperatorchartversioncode-1466/"><code>ErrReconcileOperatorChartVersionCode-1466</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Error deploying Meshery Operator at the configured chart version</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrReconcileOperatorChartVersionCode-1466" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrReconcileOperatorChartVersionCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The requested Meshery Operator Helm chart version does not exist in the chart repository, or the cluster rejected the Helm release.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Confirm the chart version exists in the Meshery Operator Helm repository, or clear operator.version to track the Meshery Server release.
Confirm the cluster is reachable and the Meshery namespace is writable.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrAnonymousUserIDMissingCode-1467" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrAnonymousUserIDMissingCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrAnonymousUserIDMissingCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1467" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/erranonymoususeridmissingcode-1467/"><code>ErrAnonymousUserIDMissingCode-1467</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Anonymous user session could not be established</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrAnonymousUserIDMissingCode-1467" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrAnonymousUserIDMissingCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details">The remote provider&#39;s anonymous user flow response contained no userId.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The remote provider does not implement the schemas v1beta2 AnonymousFlowResponse contract, or it returned an empty user id.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Confirm the configured remote provider is reachable and up to date, then retry signing in.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrNoOperatorChartPublishedCode-1468" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrNoOperatorChartPublishedCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrNoOperatorChartPublishedCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1468" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errnooperatorchartpublishedcode-1468/"><code>ErrNoOperatorChartPublishedCode-1468</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>No Meshery Operator Helm chart is published</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrNoOperatorChartPublishedCode-1468" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrNoOperatorChartPublishedCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The chart repository index was served from an unexpected location, its published charts were removed, or it currently carries only prerelease charts, which Meshery never selects on its own.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">To deploy a prerelease chart deliberately, set operator.version on the Kubernetes connection to that exact version.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrOperatorChartNotPinnedCode-1469" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrOperatorChartNotPinnedCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrOperatorChartNotPinnedCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1469" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/erroperatorchartnotpinnedcode-1469/"><code>ErrOperatorChartNotPinnedCode-1469</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Meshery Operator chart version is not a released version</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrOperatorChartNotPinnedCode-1469" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrOperatorChartNotPinnedCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">A moving tag (for example stable-latest or edge-latest) or a non-version string was configured as the operator chart version.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Set operator.version to a released chart version, or clear it to track this Meshery Server release. This error&#39;s cause names the newest released version.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrOperatorChartNotPublishedCode-1470" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrOperatorChartNotPublishedCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrOperatorChartNotPublishedCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1470" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/erroperatorchartnotpublishedcode-1470/"><code>ErrOperatorChartNotPublishedCode-1470</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Meshery Operator chart version is not published</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrOperatorChartNotPublishedCode-1470" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrOperatorChartNotPublishedCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The configured chart version was mistyped, or it was never published to the Meshery Helm chart repository.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Set operator.version to a published chart version, or clear it to track this Meshery Server release. This error&#39;s cause names the newest published version.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrOperatorChartSubstitutedCode-1471" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrOperatorChartSubstitutedCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrOperatorChartSubstitutedCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1471" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/erroperatorchartsubstitutedcode-1471/"><code>ErrOperatorChartSubstitutedCode-1471</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Meshery Operator was deployed at a different chart version than this server&#39;s release</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrOperatorChartSubstitutedCode-1471" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrOperatorChartSubstitutedCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The chart version matching this Meshery Server release is either not published yet or is too old to deploy successfully.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">No action is required. To choose the chart version yourself, set operator.version on the Kubernetes connection.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrNoMesheryReleasesFoundCode-1472" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrNoMesheryReleasesFoundCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrNoMesheryReleasesFoundCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1472" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errnomesheryreleasesfoundcode-1472/"><code>ErrNoMesheryReleasesFoundCode-1472</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>No Meshery releases were found</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrNoMesheryReleasesFoundCode-1472" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrNoMesheryReleasesFoundCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details">The GitHub releases listing for meshery/meshery returned no tags.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">GitHub returned an empty or filtered release listing, possibly because the request was rate-limited.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Retry later. This only affects the reported latest-version comparison; Meshery continues to run.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrHelmChartIndexCode-1473" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrHelmChartIndexCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrHelmChartIndexCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1473" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errhelmchartindexcode-1473/"><code>ErrHelmChartIndexCode-1473</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Unable to read the Helm chart repository index.</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrHelmChartIndexCode-1473" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrHelmChartIndexCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The Helm chart repository is unreachable, returned an error, or served an index that is not valid YAML. Meshery Server may have no outbound network access, or the repository may be temporarily unavailable.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Confirm that the chart repository named in this error&#39;s cause is reachable from the Meshery Server pod or container, then retry. If Meshery runs behind a proxy, confirm the proxy environment variables are set on the server.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrOperatorControllersHelperCode-1474" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrOperatorControllersHelperCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrOperatorControllersHelperCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1474" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/erroperatorcontrollershelpercode-1474/"><code>ErrOperatorControllersHelperCode-1474</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Unable to reach Meshery Operator lifecycle for this Kubernetes connection</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrOperatorControllersHelperCode-1474" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrOperatorControllersHelperCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The connection is not connected yet, or its state machine has not finished initializing.</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Wait for the Kubernetes connection to reach the connected state, then retry.
If it stays disconnected, check the connection&#39;s diagnostics for why its Kubernetes client could not be created.</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrInvalidDependencyCode-1475" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrInvalidDependencyCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrInvalidDependencyCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1475" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errinvaliddependencycode-1475/"><code>ErrInvalidDependencyCode-1475</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>A component declares its dependencies in a form Meshery cannot read</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrInvalidDependencyCode-1475" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrInvalidDependencyCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The design was written by a tool that spells the dependsOn entry differently, or was hand-edited outside of Meshery</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Edit the design so that the dependsOn entry on that component is a list of the names of other components in the same design</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrUnresolvedDependencyCode-1476" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrUnresolvedDependencyCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrUnresolvedDependencyCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1476" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errunresolveddependencycode-1476/"><code>ErrUnresolvedDependencyCode-1476</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>A component depends on something that is not a component of the design</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrUnresolvedDependencyCode-1476" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrUnresolvedDependencyCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The component that was depended upon has been renamed or removed while the dependency on it was left in place</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Open the design in Meshery and either restore a component with the name that was depended upon, or remove that dependency</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrAmbiguousDependencyCode-1477" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrAmbiguousDependencyCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrAmbiguousDependencyCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1477" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errambiguousdependencycode-1477/"><code>ErrAmbiguousDependencyCode-1477</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>A component depends on a name that more than one component of the design carries</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrAmbiguousDependencyCode-1477" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrAmbiguousDependencyCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">Component names are not required to be unique within a design, and more than one component was given the same name</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Open the design in Meshery and rename those components so that the one being depended upon is uniquely named</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrUnknownPlanNodeCode-1478" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrUnknownPlanNodeCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrUnknownPlanNodeCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1478" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errunknownplannodecode-1478/"><code>ErrUnknownPlanNodeCode-1478</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>The execution plan refers to a component that is not part of it</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrUnknownPlanNodeCode-1478" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrUnknownPlanNodeCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The design is internally inconsistent: it declares a dependency on a component that it does not contain</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Open the design in Meshery, remove or repoint the dangling dependency, and try again</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrCyclicDependencyCode-1479" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrCyclicDependencyCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrCyclicDependencyCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1479" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errcyclicdependencycode-1479/"><code>ErrCyclicDependencyCode-1479</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>The components of a design depend on each other in a loop</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrCyclicDependencyCode-1479" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrCyclicDependencyCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">Two or more components of the design declare a dependency on each other, either directly or through a chain of other components</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Open the design in Meshery and remove one of the dependencies that closes the loop, then try again</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrDependencyNotSatisfiedCode-1480" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrDependencyNotSatisfiedCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrDependencyNotSatisfiedCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1480" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errdependencynotsatisfiedcode-1480/"><code>ErrDependencyNotSatisfiedCode-1480</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>A component was withheld because a component it depends on did not succeed</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrDependencyNotSatisfiedCode-1480" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrDependencyNotSatisfiedCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">A component that this one&#39;s order depends on did not succeed</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Resolve the failure reported for that component, then try the design again</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrResetInProgressCode-1481" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrResetInProgressCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrResetInProgressCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1481" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errresetinprogresscode-1481/"><code>ErrResetInProgressCode-1481</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>A database reset is already in progress</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrResetInProgressCode-1481" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrResetInProgressCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details">Seeding from a previous reset has not finished; starting another would drop tables mid-seed</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">A reset was requested while an earlier one was still seeding keys, catalog designs, or components</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Wait for the in-flight reset to finish, then retry</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrNoSystemEventSinkCode-1482" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrNoSystemEventSinkCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrNoSystemEventSinkCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1482" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errnosystemeventsinkcode-1482/"><code>ErrNoSystemEventSinkCode-1482</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>No sink is configured for Meshery&#39;s system events</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrNoSystemEventSinkCode-1482" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrNoSystemEventSinkCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details">HandlerConfig.SystemEventPersister is nil, so events raised outside a user request - registry seeding summaries and registration failures - cannot be persisted</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">Meshery Server was built with a HandlerConfig that does not wire SystemEventPersister</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Set HandlerConfig.SystemEventPersister when constructing the handler configuration; on a released build this indicates a defect, so please report it at https://github.com/meshery/meshery/issues/new/choose</p>
            </td>
          </tr>

Report the stack trace above at https://github.com/meshery/meshery/issues/new/choose, then seed again - restart Meshery Server, or re-run the reset that triggered the seeding</p>

            </td>

            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrKeysRegisterColumnMissingCode-1486" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>

          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrKeysRegisterColumnMissingCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The header row of the keys file was renamed or dropped, so no row could be selected for registration and nothing is seeded from this file; on a fresh or reset database the Key table stays empty, while previously seeded keys are left untouched</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Restore the missing header in server/permissions/keys.csv (or the file KEYS_PATH points at) and restart Meshery Server so keys seed again</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrMigrateEventCorrelationIndexCode-1487" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrMigrateEventCorrelationIndexCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrMigrateEventCorrelationIndexCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1487" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errmigrateeventcorrelationindexcode-1487/"><code>ErrMigrateEventCorrelationIndexCode-1487</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Meshery Server could not create the index that keeps one open event per condition</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrMigrateEventCorrelationIndexCode-1487" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrMigrateEventCorrelationIndexCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The events table has more than one open event (no resolved_at) with the same owner and correlation_key, which an earlier Meshery Server could have recorded
The database is read-only, locked by another process or not reachable</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Resolve or delete the duplicate open events for that owner and correlation_key, then restart Meshery Server
Make sure Meshery Server can write to its database, or perform a hard reset</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrAttachEventErrorCode-1488" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrAttachEventErrorCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrAttachEventErrorCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1488" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errattacheventerrorcode-1488/"><code>ErrAttachEventErrorCode-1488</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>An event&#39;s metadata.error was kept in its legacy form</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrAttachEventErrorCode-1488" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrAttachEventErrorCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The error the event reports carries no MeshKit error code
The MeshKit error&#39;s causes or matched causes break the schemas EventError contract</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Report the error the event reports as a MeshKit error with a code
Fix the probable causes of the MeshKit error, or the matched cause ids its producer names, so they satisfy the EventError contract</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrInvalidClientEventCode-1489" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshery-server-ErrInvalidClientEventCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshery-server-ErrInvalidClientEventCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -1489" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/component-meshery-server/errinvalidclienteventcode-1489/"><code>ErrInvalidClientEventCode-1489</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>The event&#39;s correlation, provenance, trace or metadata.error fields are not valid</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrInvalidClientEventCode-1489" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshery-server-ErrInvalidClientEventCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">A field breaks the meshery/schemas event contract: a correlationKey, source or type outside 1 to 255 characters, an occurrenceCount below 1, a lastSeenAt before firstSeenAt, a specversion other than 1.0, or a traceId or parentId that is not W3C Trace Context hex
A metadata.error object carrying a lowercase code key breaks the schemas EventError contract: a value of the wrong JSON type or an unknown key, an empty code, a severity that is not an error severity, too many causes or remediations, a duplicate cause id, one remediation id naming two different remediations, an automatic or requiresApproval actionPolicy without an action, flat probableCause or suggestedRemediation lists that are not the ones derived from probableCauses, or a matchedCauses entry whose causeId is malformed, is not one of probableCauses, or whose confidence is outside 0 to 1. The long description names each failing field path</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Send the fields as the schemas EventPayload defines them, or omit the ones the client does not set
Send metadata.error as the schemas EventError shape (code, shortDescription and the other defined keys only), or drop it when the client has no structured error to attach</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
      </tbody>
    </table>

            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The base URL passed to the walker is not a valid URL
The base URL names a host other than github.com, which the Git Trees API cannot answer for</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Pass a valid base URL such as https://github.com to the BaseURL option
Walk a repository hosted elsewhere with Walk or WalkContext, which clone it with go-git</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrNoFileInterceptorCode-11332" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshkit-ErrNoFileInterceptorCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshkit-ErrNoFileInterceptorCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -11332" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/library-meshkit/errnofileinterceptorcode-11332/"><code>ErrNoFileInterceptorCode-11332</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>No file interceptor is registered to receive the fetched files</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrNoFileInterceptorCode-11332" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshkit-ErrNoFileInterceptorCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details">Fetching hands every file it downloads to a registered file interceptor, and the walker has none</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">RegisterFileInterceptor was not called on the walker before the files were fetched</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Call RegisterFileInterceptor with the function that should receive each fetched file</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrRootNotFoundCode-11333" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshkit-ErrRootNotFoundCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshkit-ErrRootNotFoundCode-more-info');">
            <td class="tbl-severity-alert">Alert</td>
            <td id=" -11333" class="error-name-code">
              <a href="/reference/error-codes/library-meshkit/errrootnotfoundcode-11333/"><code>ErrRootNotFoundCode-11333</code></a>
            </td>
            <td>Could not find the configured root path in the repository</td>
            <td><a href="https://discuss.meshery.io/search?q=ErrRootNotFoundCode-11333" target="_blank">search forum</a></td>
          </tr>
          <tr id="meshkit-ErrRootNotFoundCode-more-info" class="tbl-hidden-row">
            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The directory or file was renamed or removed on the reference being walked
The root belongs to a different branch, tag or reference than the one configured</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Verify the root path exists on the reference being walked
Walk the repository with no root configured to read every file it holds</p>
            </td>
          </tr>
        
          
          
          
          
            
          
          <tr id="ErrSymlinkedRootCode-11334" class="tbl-body-row hover-effect" data-details-id="meshkit-ErrSymlinkedRootCode-more-info" onclick="toggle_visibility('meshkit-ErrSymlinkedRootCode-more-info');">

            <td style="word-break:break-all;" colspan="4">
              <div class="error-heading">Long Description</div>
              <p class="error-details"></p>
              <div class="error-heading">Probable Cause</div>
              <p class="error-details">The configured root names a committed symbolic link rather than a directory or a file</p>
              <div class="error-heading">Suggested Remediation</div>
              <p class="error-details">Walk or WalkContext the same configuration instead, which clones the repository and reads through the link
Configure the root the link points at rather than the link itself</p>
